lines.speaker: Cara as Sister Morra Tideward
lines.text: Sister Morra presses a pouch of silver into the harbormaster's hand: For the dock repairs, Harbormaster, and for keeping our boat safe while we were below.
Harbormaster Ysolde Varr is now Friendly (+3): donation for dock repairs and boat safety

lines.speaker: Harbormaster Ysolde Varr
lines.text: I won’t forget this, Sister. You’ve earned a friend in the harbor.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text:
The harbormaster’s stern face softens at last, and she gives Sister Morra a firm nod. 

What’s your next step?

clips.name: Harbormaster Ysolde Varr
clips.line: I won’t forget this, Sister. You’ve earned a friend in the harbor.
